title: PDF print: *_words fields use wrong amount (paid_amount instead of net-after-WHT)

Current code in pdf.py::_handle_thai_amount_enhancement populates pd_custom_net_total_after_wht_words etc. with thai_money_in_words(paid_amount) = 105,000 = 'หนึ่งแสนห้าพันบาทถ้วน'. Doc has pd_custom_net_total_after_wht_details=101850 (the WHT-adjusted amount, populated by user's custom code). Fix: use the _details field's value (or computed received_amount - wht_amount) as the source for the words fields, not paid_amount.

title: Editor Design View: *_words fields show literal {{ fieldname }} instead of computed value
description: Bug A. User reported: 'if you see value from other fields it all showing value in realtime, and if you see the result at print preview all showing หนึ่งแสนห้าพันบาทถ้วน'. Design view at /desk/print-designer/Receipt shows literal {{ pd_custom_net_total_after_wht_words }} etc. for the words fields, while other fields (like ยอดรับเงินสุทธิ = 101,850) show real values. Cause: the words fields are NULL in DB; getFormattedValue returns {{ fieldname }} placeholder for empty fields. Fix: add a server endpoint that calls _handle_thai_amount_enhancement to populate the words fields, and have the editor call this on doc load so MainStore.docData gets the computed values.

title: PDF print: table borders only at column header (no row separator lines)
description: User asked how to suppress horizontal lines between data rows while keeping the line at column header. Root cause: the global table style (from print_designer_settings.globalStyles.table) sets 'border: 1px solid black' on every .printTable td, so every cell has all 4 borders. Updated jinja/macros/table.html AND jinja/old_print_format.html so the macro now adds inline 'border: 0 !important' to every cell, then conditionally adds: border-top on first data row (line under column header), border-bottom on last row, border-left on first column, border-right on last column. Header cells (th) get border-top + border-bottom + side borders so the labels still have a frame. Verified in PDF: clean rows, no horizontal separators, only the table frame (top-of-data, left, right, bottom) remains.
close_reason: Fix implemented and verified. jinja/macros/table.html + jinja/old_print_format.html: macro now resets cell borders with 'border: 0 !important' and conditionally re-adds: border-top on first data row (line under column header), border-bottom on last row, border-left on first column, border-right on last column. Column header (th) keeps top/bottom/side frame. PDF verified: clean rows with no horizontal separators, only table frame remains. 30/30 tests pass. Screenshot: .claude/pdf_print_table_no_row_lines.png

Dropped the grand_total pre-condition that was blocking Payment Entry (which doesn't have grand_total). Now uses grand_total or paid_amount. Verified: shows หนึ่งแสนห้าพันบาทถ้วน in PDF.

title: PDF print: _lang=en in URL despite Print Format default Thai
description: User bug 3: URL https://aws-solution.bunchee.online/api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf?...&_lang=en shows _lang=en even though Print Format Receipt is configured with default_print_language=th. Root cause is in get_effective_language in print_designer/pdf.py which prioritizes URL _lang parameter over Print Format default_print_language. Need to either: (a) change priority order so Print Format wins over URL, or (b) investigate why URL is being built with _lang=en in the first place (Frappe Desk Print button bug). Also check if print_designer table translations are missing the Thai .po files.
close_reason: Bug 3 fixed. get_effective_language priority changed: Print Format default_print_language wins over URL _lang (which now is 3rd priority after Print Format). Verified in PDF render: Thai language active even when URL has _lang=en. Need bench restart to clear gunicorn worker caches; user already approved.
